status: Uncontrolled release development baseline; full product performance acceptance remains open.
source_state: Uncommitted workspace; unborn main. No commit or publication performed.
native_rendering_source_note: The native benchmark depends on desktop/runtime/service sources. Those inputs are unchanged from fe6e74991801c189a18dca0126cc422edb586863d8a59f66bfc9f955d6adf7f1; the later engine-only cancellation correction and its engine/worker tests are outside this benchmark dependency graph. Current aggregate source is recorded above.
measurement_conditions: macOS ARM64, 32 GiB, 10 logical CPU threads; no Cargo build active at the start of the timed runs.
IDE and normal system activity remained active. Headless reports contain measured system load. OS scheduling, binary verification and filesystem caches were not controlled.
Three headless runs use a local scripted provider, real native worker pipes and file-tool/journal work. Each run executes 80 file-tool turns and 20 active-stream cancellations.
Semantic corpus preparation is separate from query timing; timed query text varies to avoid query-embedding cache hits.

Native rendering uses production UI with real native text and offscreen Metal/WGPU, a deterministic test dispatcher and no connected host. Ten warm-ups precede 100 samples per scrolling/streaming metric.
Native report file modification time is recorded as filesystem evidence only. It is not a timestamp emitted by the measurement harness.
limitations: No claim of speedup over Python, Colibri, an alternative engine or an earlier debug build.
No physical input/IME, actual OS window launch, display/vsync/frame drops or attributable application-plus-helper memory acceptance.
Native logical viewport is 1380 by 880; physical raster scale was not recorded. CPU submission and fresh GPU allocation/render/wait/readback metrics must not be combined by adding percentiles.
Native initialization has one observation. Its emitted p95 field is not a launch-percentile estimate.
The 100,000-record workload is lexical only. No 100,000-record semantic retrieval or LongMemEval quality result is claimed.
Worker memory is a point observation of that worker alone. UI, host, embedding model/runtime, browser, inference weights, KV cache and other helpers are excluded.
No live provider/model latency, sustained mixed-resource workload, 100-connector or cross-platform acceptance.
